howItWorks.title: Three steps. Zero magic. Heavy research.
howItWorks.subtitle: What you'd do by hand, in the time it takes to make a coffee.

step1.title: Research
step1.desc: Drop a URL or a name. Firecrawl + Exa index the site and the lead's digital footprint live.

step2.title: Understand
step2.desc: The agent identifies the industry, real friction, and computes a Lead Score with explicit criteria.

step3.title: Write
step3.desc: Personalised copy for Email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp, plus 3- and 7-day follow-ups. Ready to send.

philosophy.title: The human sends. AI thought that was weakness. It isn't.
philosophy.body1: We built Nexus Sales with one deliberate decision: zero auto-send.
philosophy.body2: Other agents brag about "send 1,000 emails without lifting a finger". We flipped it: the agent does the invisible work — research, analysis, drafting — so you can do the work that matters: deciding when and how to reach out.
philosophy.body3: The result: human-outbound response rates at automated-outbound speed.

noAuto.a: Because the difference between human outbound and outbound spam is exactly that: someone deciding whether it's worth writing to that person at that moment. The agent does the research and drafting; you decide when to hit send.

privacy.q: What happens to the data of companies it analyses?
privacy.a: We only process public content from the sites you ask it to analyse. We don't store anything that isn't already public, and analyses live in your own Neon database — they aren't shared.

score.q: How is the Lead Score computed?
score.a: A weighted sum of four criteria: catalogue fit (30 pts), visible digital friction (25 pts), buying capacity (25 pts), and urgency / timing (20 pts). Every lead shows the breakdown so you understand the why.

customize.q: Can I customise the agent for my agency?
customize.a: Yes. The "Agency settings" panel edits the brief the agent uses: your value prop, tone, services, and case studies. The more specific, the better the copy.

models.q: Which AI models does it use under the hood?
models.a: GPT-5 mini via the Vercel AI Gateway by default. Swappable to Claude 4.6 or Gemini 3 with a single env var (NEXUS_MODEL).

pricing.a: Open source for the hackathon. To run it on your own account, costs are your Vercel + Neon + AI Gateway. The public hero demo is rate-limited to 3 analyses per IP per hour.

whatIs.title: What is Nexus Sales?
whatIs.body: Nexus Sales is an AI sales agent built for software agencies. It analyses companies as prospects and generates personalised outreach copy ready to copy and paste.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.step1: Drop the URL or name of a company into the Co-Pilot.
howItWorks.step2: The agent researches the site, detects problems and opportunities, and computes a Lead Score across 4 criteria.
howItWorks.step3: Email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp copy is generated automatically, referencing specific signals from the lead.
howItWorks.step4: Copy the message you like best and send it manually.
howItWorks.step5: Save the lead in the CRM and update its status as it progresses.

leadScore.title: Lead Score
leadScore.intro: The score (0–100) measures how good a prospect the company is for your agency:
leadScore.criteria1: Catalog fit (30 pts): does their problem match what you offer?
leadScore.criteria2: Visible digital friction (25 pts): is there evidence of a real issue on their site?
leadScore.criteria3: Size / buying capacity (25 pts): are there signals they can pay?
leadScore.criteria4: Urgency / timing (20 pts): is there a recent trigger (growth, hiring, launch)?

philosophy.title: Product philosophy
philosophy.body: Nexus Sales does not send messages automatically. That's a deliberate decision: you decide when and how to reach out. The AI does the research and writing; human judgment picks the moment.

config.title: Configuration
config.body: Open “Agency settings” to customise your agency brief. The more specific you are (services, cases, tone), the better the generated copy.
